Question
========

Which of the following commands will install *only* the **lavaan** package from CRAN?

Answerlist
----------

* `install.packages("lavaan")`
* `install.packages("Lavaan")`
* `install.packages(c("lavaan", "dplyr"))`
* `install.packages("dplyr")`
* `library(lavaan)`
* `ls(lavaan)`
* `help(lavaan)`

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------

* **Yes:** This call installs the **lavaan** package and nothing else
* **No:** This call will error because the package name is mis-capitalized
* **No:** This call will install both **lavaan** and **dplyr**
* **No:** This call installs **dplyr**
* **No:** This call loads the **lavaan** package
* **No:** This line represents a misuse of the `ls()` function
* **No:** This call opens the help file for the `lavaan()` function
